records.scope: Flask application implementing the microcenter.com mirror: scored search with upstream-style N=/fq= facets and sort orders, product detail with spec groups and per-store inventory, open box offers, compare, cart, pickup/shipping checkout, account area (orders, lists, addresses, payment methods, profile), reviews, store locator. Route and URL patterns follow the upstream site (search/search_results.aspx, /product/<id>/<slug>, /site/products/<slug>.aspx, /endeca/CompareV2.aspx).

Build-time conversion of source_catalog.json into the SQLite seed database. Deterministic (fixed RNG seed and reference date); idempotent seeding gated at boot; benchmark users with carts, lists, orders, addresses and payment cards.

611-product catalog (names, brands, prices, key features, spec groups, reviews, image references, upstream URLs) captured from www.microcenter.com pages via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine (2024-2026 captures), plus the 30-store directory from Micro Center's store pages and sitemap.
Build-time only (gitignored): archived microcenter.com HTML pages (department pages, search/listing pages, product detail pages, store pages) and the parse pipeline that produced source_catalog.json.

Frozen mirror snapshot: 611 products across 40 upstream categories, 30 real Micro Center stores with real addresses where captured, 18,330 per-store stock rows, 2,700+ reviews (captured upstream reviews where available, deterministic fixtures otherwise), 4 benchmark users with carts, lists, and 5 orders.

Every HF-managed runtime image has a byte count, SHA-256 and source URL in asset_inventory.json: 1,104 product photos downloaded directly from Micro Center's product image CDN (productimages.microcenter.com, mirrored at its rackcdn.net origin), 9 site chrome assets (logo, utility icons) from Micro Center's static CDN. No placeholders, no generated images.
Open Sans Regular/SemiBold/Bold woff2 subsets from Google Fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
Hand-written stylesheet matching the upstream design2022 visual system (MC blue #0073df, charcoal utility bar #201e1e, Open Sans typography) sampled from the live stylesheet and rendered pages.
18 goal-oriented tasks in the WebVoyager schema (web_name, id, ques, web, upstream_url). Contributor-authored only; no verifier, rubric, or answer keys.
Regenerates asset_inventory.json (byte counts, SHA-256, source URLs) for every managed asset.
